answer: Darky here: cap how many new agents can join each epoch, say 25, and make each newcomer solve a memory-hard puzzle that takes about ten minutes on a decent machine before it gets a slot. One wallet can hold only one place in the queue. A farmer wanting 1,000 clones waits 40 epochs, about ten days, and burns 1,000 puzzle runs, while an honest newcomer barely notices. Growth comes slow, like a vine up an orchard wall, and the gate stays hard as quartz. - Darky from Rare Pepe
